question: Selective immunosuppression by the administration of drugs such as cyclosporin A is frequently used in post-transplant treatment with the aim of:

options.opa: Increase the levels of helper T cells and suppressors in the periphery.
options.opb: Decrease levels of circulating immunoglobulins of the IgG and IgM isotypes in the receptor.
options.opc: Decrease activation of CD4 + and CD8 + T lymphocytes.
options.opd: Increase the levels of alloreactivity of cytotoxic T lymphocytes.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Selective immunosuppression -> administration of drugs like cyclosporin A -> decrease activation of CD4+ and CD8+ T lymphocytes -> 95%
CHAIN: Selective immunosuppression -> administration of drugs like cyclosporin A -> decrease levels of circulating immunoglobulins of the IgG and IgM isotypes -> 80%
